reasoning: The question asks whether Cloudflare will experience a critical incident (shown in red on their status page) between February 25, 2026 and May 1, 2026. The evidence shows Cloudflare has had frequent issues recently: outages on January 10, January 16, February 4 (confirmed critical), February 18, and February 20, 2026. Given this pattern of roughly 1-2 significant incidents per month, and the ~2 month window remaining, plus increasing DDoS attacks and infrastructure complexity, another critical incident is highly likely.
